value.rationale: Complete natural moduli invariant for all embedded ideals of an infinite non-Gorenstein Artinian local family: every equivalence class and its orbit size, a linear-in-length count uniform in the field despite arbitrarily many individual ideals as q grows. It distinguishes affine graph, multiplicative and projective boundary actions; this is an orbit problem not solved by the existing ideal census alone.
